name: Eheim Pro 4+ 350 (2273)
description: Premium German-engineered canister filter with pre-filter cartridge and Xtender bypass for extended media-cleaning intervals. Manufacturer-rated pump output is 1050 L/h; effective in-tank turnover after media + plumbing losses is typically lower (real-world tests cite ~600-700 L/h), but we keep the manufacturer figure as the canonical spec.
